title: Copy and swap
description:
Write a small string class from scratch, using the **copy-and-swap** idiom for assignment.

`Text` owns a heap array of characters ending in `'\0'`.

- `Text(const char* source)`: copies the characters (a null pointer gives an empty text).
- Copy constructor: deep copy.
- Destructor.
- `friend void swap(Text& a, Text& b) noexcept`: exchanges the two objects' pointers and lengths.
- `Text& operator=(Text other)`: the parameter is taken **by value**, so it is already a copy; swap with it and return. The old contents leave with `other` when it is destroyed. One function handles everything, self-assignment included.
- `std::size_t length() const`, `const char* c_str() const`, and `char& operator[](std::size_t)`.
